title: Craftpunk — Society
description: Primitives for a tended, co-inhabited commons: shared civic space, nature on its own clock, AI neighbors with standing, and reputation that flows from care.
boundary: Nothing here is wired into engine core. A primitive is promoted to code in engine/ only when a SECOND, unrelated world needs it. Until then this manifest names the boundary so Craftpunk-shaped logic never leaks into the kernel.

components.name: Commons
components.why: Marks an entity as shared civic space with a liveliness/upkeep level that decays without tending and rises with care.
reusableBy: a village-sim where a town square thrives or empties
a co-op base-builder scoring shared upkeep over loot

components.name: Cultivable
components.why: A patch of nature on a seasonal clock — grows, ripens, and can be neglected or over-harvested; some change is slow or irreversible.

components.name: Conversant
components.why: Gives a character standing as a neighbor: persistent memory, own upkeep, and disposition toward others — the hook for cohabitation drama, not a vending machine.
reusableBy: a narrative RPG with companions who remember

components.name: Reputation
components.why: A durable standing value that accrues from tending the commons and neighbors rather than from accumulation or combat.

types.name: Steward
types.why: A player/agent whose scarce resource is attention (finite care spent per session across self, commons, and neighbors).
reusableBy: a caretaker/roguelite about spending a limited daily action budget

behaviors.name: decayAndTend
behaviors.why: The upkeep loop: Commons/Cultivable liveliness drifts down over time and rises on a tend action. Code-backed; write it only when a second world needs the same loop.
